34:   scoredCount: number;
35:   /** `abstained` + `needs_review`. */
36:   abstentionCount: number;
37:   /** Erro médio absoluto |score − referenceScore| entre os scored. */
38:   meanAbsoluteError: number;

55: function roundTo(value: number, decimals: number): number {
56:   const factor = 10 ** decimals;
57:   const rounded = Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * factor) / factor;
58:   return Object.is(rounded, -0) ? 0 : rounded;

62:   return item.verdict === "scored" && typeof item.score === "number";

67: }
